newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Andalusia mulls Sevillana buy.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Andalusia mulls Sevillana buy.

text.p: Spain's Andalusian regional government said on Wednesday it was not ruling out a bid for a 24 percent stake in regional electricity company Sevillana de Electricidad from Endesa, local media reported.

Endesa, itself 66 percent state-owned, launched an offer for up to 75 percent of Sevillana last week. The sale of a 24 percent stake to the Junta de Andalusia would mean it would still retain control with 51 percent.

Before the government authorised Endesa's bid for Sevillana, the Junta offered the Industry Ministry 110 billion pesetas for Endesa's previously-held 40 percent stake, Industry and Employment department official Guillermo Gutierrez told journalists.
But the ministry turned down the offer.
Gutierrez described the possible purchase of 24 percent of Sevillana as "a bad solution because Andalusia wanted a majority stake in Sevillana and not a minority in Endesa".
